missed.why: "remains responsible to Customer for the acts and omissions of each Subcontractor": the check looks for "liable" wording, so this present flow-down clause was reported missing. Not fixed: it was found on this pack, so fixing it would need another new pack.
"purged no later than forty-five (45) days": the DPA sentence has none of the deletion words the check looks for, so 2 weeks vs 45 days was not compared.
"No, data never leaves the EEA" starts with "No", so it was not read as an EU-only claim.
The answer is stricter than the DPA (no on-site audits, while the DPA allows them); only the opposite direction is checked.
A building fire-safety "inspection" was taken as a possible audit clause.
Two documents give different notice periods for new sub-processors; not flagged as a conflict.
"Where is customer data hosted?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"What information will a breach notification contain?": the right passage was not in the top 5.
"Do you operate a 24/7 security operations centre?": the right passage was not in the top 5.

history.text: Vendor checks on packs F and G, written after the checks: 7 of 11 contradictions found; 1 of 9 consistent answers wrongly flagged.

Fixed the v1 misses ("calendar days", sub-processors left out of a list, "all data within the EU", audits through a report). On new pack H, written after these fixes: 3 of 6 found, 0 of 4 consistent answers flagged. Packs F and G now pass 11 of 11, but they shaped the fixes, so they no longer count as unseen.

Owner-approved hint changes to two Art. 28 rules (added "infringes the GDPR" to A28-3-a2; removed the too-general "personnel" from A28-3-b; requirement text and severity unchanged). On new pack I: missing clauses found 2/3 before, 3/3 after; present clauses wrongly reported missing 1/9 before, 0/9 after. No pack got more false flags.

New pack N2, written in a new drafting style and keyed before a single run, with no rule changes: missing clauses found 2 of 3; present clauses wrongly reported missing 1 of 9. Both misses are published below. N2 now counts as a training pack: later fixes are measured on a new pack.

Owner-approved hint changes for the two N2 misses (A28-3-d: wording for engaging subcontracted processors; A28-3-f: a plain breach notice no longer counts as assistance with Articles 32 to 36; requirement text and severity unchanged). N2 shaped them, so it moved to the training packs; its first-run result stays above. On new pack N3 (one pack, small sample), keyed before any run: missing clauses 2/3 before, 3/3 after; present clauses wrongly reported missing 2/9 before, 1/9 after. Caveat: N3 was written after the fix was decided, by the same author. No pack got more false flags.
